input: Set up a side hustle tracking spreadsheet

gold.taskTitle: Build a Side Hustle Tracking Spreadsheet
gold.taskDescription: Set up a spreadsheet to track the performance, finances, or activity of a side hustle.

questions.title: What type of side hustle are you tracking?
questions.description: Understand the nature of the side hustle (e.g. freelancing, reselling, content creation, delivery driving) to tailor the spreadsheet structure.

questions.title: What is the main purpose of this spreadsheet?
questions.description: Determine the primary goal: tracking income, expenses, time spent, client projects, inventory, or a combination.

questions.title: Which spreadsheet tool do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify the platform the user prefers, such as Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, Notion, or Airtable.

questions.title: How often will you update this spreadsheet?
questions.description: Establish the update frequency (daily, weekly, per transaction) to design the right input workflow.

questions.title: Do you need to track taxes or set-aside amounts?
questions.description: Find out if the spreadsheet should include tax estimation columns or savings rate calculations.

questions.title: Do you have multiple income streams to separate?
questions.description: Determine whether the user runs one side hustle or several that need to be tracked distinctly.

questions.title: Do you have an income or profit goal to measure against?
questions.description: Identify whether a target figure or milestone should be built into the tracker for progress visibility.
